# Closed 1337+ era window (R31 & R44 compliant; never leaks into pre-1337 Chronicles eras).
oe_v58_sea_era_window = {
	current_year >= 1337
	current_year <= 1837
}

# Khmer & Angkor core realms (100% verified vanilla TAG + location).
oe_v58_sea_is_khmer = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { tag = ELR }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
	OR = {
		tag = KHM
		owns = location:angkor
	}
}

# Burma: Toungoo (TNG), Hanthawaddy (PEG), Pinya (PIN), Sagaing (SAG), Prome (BPR), Arakan (ARK)
# plus Irrawaddy geographic match so Chronicles Taungu Burma (TAU, capital pinya) works seamlessly!
oe_v58_sea_is_burma = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	NOT = { tag = ELR }
	NOT = { has_variable = oe_ely_voyager }
	OR = {
		tag = TNG
		tag = PEG
		tag = PIN
		tag = SAG
		tag = BPR
		tag = ARK
		owns = location:pagan
		owns = location:taungoo
		owns = location:pegu
		capital ?= {
			OR = {
				area = area:irrawady_area
				area = area:irrawady_delta_area
				area = area:arakhan_area
			}
		}
	}
}
